items.title: GTA 6’s Mandy Could Be Hiding A Killer Secret
items.summary: One of the first characters you meet in the opening chapter of Rockstar's GTA 6 is Mandy, and people online are thirsting hard for her. However, fans have also discovered evidence that they believe points to Mandy being a serial killer. While Jason is fixing Mandy's sink, he discovers an object--a severed finger--was the cause of the blockage. Mandy snaps it away from him quickly, presumably to hide the evidence.
